messages:
James H: urgent heads-up — ClearBank (dedicated pool) started seeing intermittent 5xx + p99 token latency spikes around 03:40 UTC. Checkout flows affected. Need short-term mitigation and an owner to update the customer.
Maya R: looking. dashboards -> https://grafana.internal/redwood/clearbank?from=now-1h :eyes:
Maya R: is this only pool-042 or across their dedicated nodes?
Nishant K: pool-042 shows memory pressure and KV-cache evictions correlated with long-context requests. kernel logs show repeated eviction/reload.
Li W: confirmed model is gpt-2xlong-v3 (long ctx) — KV cache grows a lot and we're hitting OOMs on a subset of older T4s. Evictions trigger 5xx across the process.
James H: ok. options: (A) lower max_seq/trim prefix cache, (B) route customer to v3-lite quantized variant, (C) short-term rate-limit. Need owner for infra patch + owner for routing override.
Maya R: @nishant can you take infra patch? want a short canary and then roll.
Nishant K: can do. I'll open a PR to reduce kv_cache_limit and enable prefix_cutoff for pool-042. Rolling canary to 1 node first.
Nishant K: PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4211 (rolling canary now)
James H: @li can you prepare routing override to v3-lite for ClearBank? should be quick via routing feature-flag.
Li W: will do. creating model alias and routing override. preparing curl snippet now.
Li W: curl snippet for routing override:\n```\nPOST /api/v1/routing/overrides\n{\n  \"customer\": \"clearbank\",\n  \"route_to\": \"gpt-2xlong-v3-lite\",\n  \"reason\": \"kv-cache OOM mitigation\",\n  \"ttl\": 7200\n}\n```\nLi W: ready to apply on your mark.
Sam P: customer expects an update in ~1h. need a brief acknowledgement now and ETA for fix. can we confirm within 30m?
Maya R: we can provide a 30m acknowledgement + action plan. James can send the customer note.
incident-bot: INC-2026-7683 created: clearbank-dedicated-spike — severity P1, assigned: eng-platform
James H: draft customer note: \"We're investigating increased errors on your Dedicated deployment. We've started targeted mitigations (routing fallback + infra patch). We'll update within 30 minutes with actions and ETA.\" ok to send?
Maya R: :thumbsup: send it.
James H: sent to ClearBank (support ticket #CB-1284) — linking here: https://support.internal/tickets/CB-1284
Nishant K: canary results: 1/1 node stable for 8m, no OOMs on the canary. starting roll to remaining 3 nodes.
Maya R: monitoring -> errors down ~78% on canary nodes, p99 token latency down from ~4.2s to ~1.1s. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/clearbank?from=now-30m
Li W: applied routing override -> clearbank now routed to gpt-2xlong-v3-lite. fallback active. I'll keep alias in place until infra change is fully rolled and kernel patch tested.
Nishant K: roll complete to all pool-042 nodes. infra config PR merged. nodes healthy.
Sam P: customer notified that mitigation is in place and we're working on long-term fix. they asked for a follow-up once kernel patch is scheduled.
Li W: opening R&D ticket to investigate kernel/hotpath for KV-cache handling with long contexts. Ticket -> https://jira.internal/browse/ML-987
Maya R: quick recap of owners/actions: 1) Nishant — infra patch & roll (done), 2) Li — routing override + R&D ticket (done/open), 3) James — customer comms (done). Monitoring to continue for 2h, then we can remove fallback if stable.
James H: thanks all. I'll keep the thread updated if customer asks more. marking this thread as the coordination record for CB-1284. :raised_hands:
Maya R: leaving monitoring notes in the incident doc. if anything regresses ping @oncall.
